predictions.claim: SpaceX will go public next month at a valuation around $1.8 trillion (down from >$2T).
predictions.speaker: Benedikt Kammel
predictions.notes: Musk publicly replied 'false' to the lowered figure.

predictions.claim: Both Anthropic and OpenAI could IPO as soon as this fall (2026).
predictions.speaker: Shirin Ghaffary / Rebecca Torrence
predictions.notes: Anthropic's $65B round did not change its IPO timeline.

predictions.claim: AI will cause ~15% net displacement of knowledge workers, possibly within single-digit years and as soon as three.
predictions.speaker: Carson Block (Muddy Waters)
predictions.notes: Net losses because capability outpaces human adaptation.

predictions.claim: AI will lift US trend real GDP growth to about 2.4% over the next 10 years, with ~25% of tasks automated gradually.
predictions.speaker: Matthew Weir (Goldman Sachs)
predictions.notes: Goldman expects more jobs created than lost in aggregate.

predictions.claim: Memory will remain the AI hardware bottleneck for at least the next two years.
predictions.speaker: Janet Mui (RBC Brewin Dolphin)
predictions.notes: Cited as an investable area; Micron passed $1T market cap.

predictions.claim: SpaceX's IPO could raise as much as $75 billion, making it the largest IPO of all time.
predictions.speaker: Bloomberg Originals
predictions.notes: Would more than double Saudi Aramco's $29.4B 2019 record.

predictions.claim: Taiwan will post ~9.64% GDP growth in 2026, its fastest export growth in 50 years (~40% export rise).
predictions.speaker: show hosts
